dcat_keyword_sm: A city that is green and resilient.
dct_description_sm:
The data sets are annual summaries of the untreated Ottawa River water, the Treated water leaving each drinking water purification plant (Britannia and Lemieux Island) plus the Central Distribution System for each calendar year. These data sets are summaries of selected key physical, chemical, microbiological and radiological parameters. Full water quality summaries are available online at: http://www.ottawa.ca/en/env_water/water_sewer/water_wells/wells/city_wells/index.html.

Accuracy: There are no known errors with this data report

Update Frequency: Updated monthly

Attributes: These data sets include the minimum, maximum and average values for selected physical, chemical, microbiological and radiological parameters, as well as the number of times each parameter was analysed at each of the two drinking water purification plants in Ottawa.

Contact: nfo water

Download note: If you are having problems downloading using Microsoft Edge as your web browser, try disabling the “Open Office files in the browser” option in Settings.
